title: Gold, silver rate today, 29 March: Check live price of 24 kt, 22 kt, 18 kt gold and 10 gm, 100 gm, 1 kg silver | Stock Market News
summary: Gold and silver prices in India remained flat due to geopolitical tensions, including the Israel-US-Iran conflict, and other factors such as US Treasury yields and a strong US Dollar. However, gold showed a recovery, while silver prices fell slightly.
sentiment_reason: The neutral to slightly negative sentiment is due to the geopolitical tensions and volatile market factors affecting gold and silver prices, despite a solid recovery in gold prices.
